summary: A Yes vote adopts Ordinance No. 2026-01, approving agreements with Mercy Housing California 110, L.P., including a 99-year ground lease of City land at $1 per year, to develop and operate a 40-unit affordable senior residential project for agricultural workers with a 2,653-square-foot community space at 535-555 Kelly Avenue.

housing.text: The Yes campaign supports allowing a 40-unit affordable housing project for senior agricultural workers to proceed.
housing.quote: A "Yes" vote confirms the City Council's approval of the ground lease and lets the project move forward as planned.

housing.text: A No vote would reject the ordinance authorizing agreements for an affordable housing development for senior agricultural workers.
housing.quote: A “NO” vote is a vote against Measure Q and against adopting Ordinance 2026-01.
